name: bewlybewly-avemujica
description: Just make a few small changes to your bilibili homepage.

scripts.dev: bun run clear && concurrently "bun run dev:prepare" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:js" "bun run dev:bg"
scripts.dev-firefox: bun run clear-firefox && cross-env NODE_ENV=development FIREFOX=true concurrently "bun run dev:prepare" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:js" "bun run dev:bg"
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run clear && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run build:web && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run build:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run build:js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run build:bg
scripts.build-safari: cross-env NODE_ENV=production SAFARI=true bun run clear-safari && NODE_ENV=production SAFARI=true bun run build:web &&NODE_ENV=production SAFARI=true bun run build:prepare &&NODE_ENV=production SAFARI=true bun run build:js &&NODE_ENV=production SAFARI=true bun run build:bg
scripts.build-firefox: cross-env NODE_ENV=production FIREFOX=true bun run clear-firefox && NODE_ENV=production FIREFOX=true bun run build:web && NODE_ENV=production FIREFOX=true bun run build:prepare && NODE_ENV=production FIREFOX=true bun run build:js && NODE_ENV=production FIREFOX=true bun run build:bg
scripts.pack: cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently "bun run pack:zip" "bun run pack:zip-firefox" "bun run pack:zip-firefox-sources" "bun run pack:crx" "bun run pack:xpi"
scripts.pack:zip-firefox-sources: rimraf extension-firefox-sources.zip && git archive HEAD -o extension-firefox-sources.zip
scripts.pack:xpi: cross-env WEB_EXT_ARTIFACTS_DIR=./ FIREFOX=true web-ext build --source-dir ./extension-firefox --filename extension.xpi --overwrite-dest
